title: papyrus monitors overview and page: read monitoring through the signed-in site API
description: Add read-only CLI commands over the existing monitoringOverview and monitoringPage queries (amplify/functions/monitoring-view/schema.ts), the same API lib/monitoring-client.ts uses. Options: --scope publication|all (all is admin-only, enforced by the server), list and cursor for pages, --json. Uses the user's papyrus login, never boto3 or an AWS profile, with no IAM fallback. A signed-out or non-staff user gets a clear refusal. No server changes. Gherkin scenarios plus unit tests; document it on p.apyr.us.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented in PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/1044, merged to develop (not promoted to main, not released). papyrus monitors overview|page, signed-in only. Tests: pytest procedures/newsroom/tests/test_monitoring_view_cli.py (12 pass), behave features_backend/cli-monitors-overview.feature (7 scenarios pass). Docs page on p.apyr.us left for release.
